disclaimer: Status reflects what exists in the beta today. 'idea' means nobody has promised it. Suggestions are welcome but do not guarantee a feature will ship.

features.name: Chat with BluEmpress
features.summary: Talk to an AI queen character in the BluRoom. Replies come from Google's Gemini models.

features.name: Moods and portraits
features.summary: Nine moods, each with its own portrait. The face changes with the tone of the conversation.

features.name: Chat modes
features.summary: Regal, Focused, Playful, Guarded, and BluRoom modes change her tone and length.

features.name: BluRoom Check
features.summary: A rare random moment where her eyes and crown glow and she resets the energy with extra sass.

features.name: Quick actions
features.summary: One-tap starters: brainstorm, write, plan, worldbuild, goals, script, app plan, design, and content.

features.name: Memory you control
features.summary: Temporary, long-term, and user-controlled memories you can add, review, and export.

features.name: Studio desk
features.summary: Tasks, reminders, notes, goals, and projects you can chat with her about.

features.name: Voice
features.summary: Hold to speak and auto-read replies. Android uses the phone's TextToSpeech; browsers use Web Speech.

features.name: Music, sound, and mood intensity
features.summary: Background music, sound effects, volume, speed, particles, theme, and sliders for mood and BluRoom Check intensity.

features.name: Bridge
features.summary: Bring a name into the room on purpose and remove it again when you are done.

features.name: Report an AI reply
features.summary: Tap Report on any reply to flag it for review.

features.name: iPhone and web version
features.summary: Open the web app in Safari and use Add to Home Screen. Not an App Store app.

features.name: Premium voice options
features.summary: Optional higher-quality voices. Not available today.

features.name: More moods and portraits
features.summary: Community suggestions for new moods are welcome in data/moods.json.

features.name: More BluRoom Check lines
features.summary: A bigger pool of classy sass lines.
